local self=require('openmw.self')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local core=require('openmw.core')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local ready=false
local damaged=false
local timer=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 local health=Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current
 assert(health>0,'Player died during autonomous rat admission')
 if not ready then ready=true print('Northern rats admission ready') end
 if not damaged and health<73 then damaged=true print('Northern rats damaged Player') end
 timer=timer+dt
 if timer>=1 then timer=0 print('Northern rats Player health='..health)
  for _,id in ipairs({{0x38172,0x38173,0x38171}}) do
   local actor=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',id))
   if actor and actor:isValid() then print('Northern rat '..id..' distance='..(actor.position-self.position):length()..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(actor).current..' dead='..tostring(Actor.isDead(actor))) end
  end
 end
end}}}}
